notes: Exceptions for ci/scripts/security_severity_gate.py. Every entry needs id, reason and expires (YYYY-MM-DD); expired entries stop matching. Optional scanner (trivy or pip-audit), package and severity narrow the match. Never allowlist a finding that has a fix inside the pinned range: upgrade instead.

allow.reason: ncurses in the python:3.12-slim (Debian trixie) base image has no Debian security update yet. Remove when the base digest is rebuilt with a fix.
